device: the owner's MiSTer (DE10-Nano), Main_MiSTer binary of 2026-10-19
loaded_with: MGL via /dev/MiSTer_cmd load_core (_Console/GBA, file type f index 0)
timing: real time: script frames played as wall-clock 1/60 s by work/mister/mrun.py

options.config/GBA.CFG: Autosave On (status bit 23), every other option at its default; written for the run and removed after

save_trigger: OSD opened (F12 from a uinput keyboard) with Autosave on: the core writes its backup RAM to the SD card
started_from: a zero-filled 8192-byte .sav put in place before loading, so the backup RAM started cleared; the core then rewrote all of it
note: 4 Kbit (512-byte) EEPROM, but the core writes every EEPROM game as 16 sectors (8192 bytes: save_sz |= 0xF in GBA.sv); bytes 512-8191 are the zero seed. Without a seed they would be whatever was in memory. The 512 bytes match mGBA's and VBA-M's .srm byte for byte in layout (same 64-bit word order). Proof: Select a Save file showing the Prologue file after loading the game again.
